title: Bathroom Renovation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription:
Full bathroom renovation in a residential property, approximately 2.8m x 3.2m (nine square metres floor area).
Demolition: Full strip-out of existing bathroom, including tiles, fixtures, plasterboard, and old shower base.
Waste Removal: Supply and manage one three cubic metre skip bin.
Wall Preparation: Install new six millimetre Villaboard cement sheeting to all wet areas (approximately sixty-seven point two square metres) and plasterboard to dry areas.
Waterproofing: Two-coat application of compliant Class Three membrane to shower recess walls (five point zero four square metres), full bathroom floor (nine square metres), and wall-to-floor junctions. Install bond breaker and reinforcing tape.
Floor Levelling: Self-levelling compound for floor if required (up to twenty millimetres).
Wall Tiles: Supply and lay six-hundred by three-hundred millimetre white rectified ceramic tiles to two point four metres height in shower recess and one point two metres height to remaining walls (total approximately forty-five square metres).
Floor Tiles: Supply and lay three-hundred by three-hundred millimetre light grey matt porcelain tiles (nine square metres).
Tiling Materials: Quality flexible tile adhesive and epoxy grout for wet areas.
Vanity: Supply and install a nine-hundred millimetre wide, wall-hung timber-look vanity with a ceramic top and single basin.
Tapware: Supply and install chrome mixer taps for vanity and shower. Supply and install a rail shower with a three-function head.
Toilet: Supply and install a back-to-wall, rimless, soft-close toilet suite.
Shower Screen: Supply and install a nine-hundred millimetre wide by two-thousand millimetre high frameless glass shower panel.
Mirror: Supply and install a nine-hundred by seven-hundred-and-fifty millimetre frameless polished edge mirror.
Accessories: Supply and install chrome toilet roll holder and towel rail.
Plumbing: Rough-in and fit-off for new vanity, toilet, shower, and floor waste. Relocate existing shower mixer and floor waste within the room.
Electrical: Install two new recessed LED downlights (ninety millimetre cut-out, ten Watt, warm white), one new exhaust fan (two-hundred-and-fifty millimetre diameter), and one double power point near the vanity. Install wiring for a new heated towel rail (client to supply).
Painting: Two coats of mould-resistant paint to non-tiled walls and ceiling.
Cleanup: Final site clean and waste removal.
workingDetail: Demolition and waste removal, Waterproofing membrane and tape, Wall and floor tiles, Tile adhesive and grout
